objective: Verify that the two primary visual elements form a clear, balanced layout.

criteria.description: A green square and a magenta circle are both fully visible, clearly separated, and balanced on opposite sides of the stage.
passAnchors: both differently colored shapes are fully visible
the shapes do not overlap and occupy opposite sides of the stage
failAnchors: a shape is clipped or outside the stage
the shapes overlap or collapse into the same area
